author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
Adam and Don Bies, former ILM model supervisor and Lucasfilm archivist, continue sharing memories and stories from their time working in the ILM model shop! Don has also brought his personal replica of Han Solo's DL-44 blaster, which provides an opportunity for Adam to bring out his own replica to compare builds and weathering techniques. 

Don Bies: https://www.thedonbies.com/
